items.title: How a Roth IRA Can Keep Thousands More of Your DJIA Dividend Income Compounding
items.summary: Holding blue-chip Dow dividend payers in a taxable account quietly hands the IRS a cut of every reinvested dollar, year after year, and the compounding cost over two decades is far steeper than most investors expect.

items.title: AMGN's Dazodalibep Meets Goal in Systemic Sjogren's Disease Study
